import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyExteriorNaturality
import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyCircleProductCup

/-!
# The range of the exterior cup comparison

Pullbacks preserve the range of the exterior-power cup comparison. Cupping
on the left with a degree-one class raises its degree by one. Together with
the actual circle-product splitting, these facts give the surjectivity step
in the finite-torus induction of Mumford, Chapter I, Section 1, p. 3.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance 2000] Prod.instModule

open CategoryTheory

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {X Y : TopCat}

/-- Pullback preserves classes generated by degree-one cup products. -/
theorem singularCohomologyExteriorPower_pullback_mem_range (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    {c : IntegralSingularCohomology Y n}
    (hc : c ∈ LinearMap.range (singularCohomologyExteriorPower Y n)) :
    singularCohomologyPullback f n c ∈
      LinearMap.range (singularCohomologyExteriorPower X n) := by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hc
  refine ⟨exteriorPower.map n (singularCohomologyPullback f 1) x, ?_⟩
  exact (LinearMap.congr_fun (singularCohomologyExteriorPower_naturality f n) x).symm

/-- Left cup by a degree-one class preserves generation by degree-one cups. -/
theorem singularCohomologyExteriorPower_cup_mem_range (n : ℕ)
    (a : IntegralSingularCohomology X 1) {b : IntegralSingularCohomology X n}
    (hb : b ∈ LinearMap.range (singularCohomologyExteriorPower X n)) :
    singularCohomologyCup X 1 n (n + 1) (Nat.add_comm 1 n) a b ∈
      LinearMap.range (singularCohomologyExteriorPower X (n + 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hb
  have hx : x ∈ Submodule.span ℤ
      (Set.range (exteriorPower.ιMulti ℤ n (M := IntegralSingularCohomology X 1))) := by
    have hspan := exteriorPower.ιMulti_span (R := ℤ) (M := IntegralSingularCohomology X 1) n
    exact hspan ▸ (show x ∈ (⊤ : Submodule ℤ _) from Submodule.mem_top)
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hx
      refine ⟨exteriorPower.ιMulti ℤ (n + 1) (Fin.cons a v), ?_⟩
      rw [singularCohomologyExteriorPower_ιMulti, singularCohomologyExteriorPower_ιMulti]
      rfl
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, Submodule.zero_mem]
  | add x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
      rw [(singularCohomologyExteriorPower X n).map_add,
        (singularCohomologyCup X 1 n (n + 1) (Nat.add_comm 1 n) a).map_add]
      exact (LinearMap.range (singularCohomologyExteriorPower X (n + 1))).add_mem ihx ihy
  | smul r x hx ih =>
      rw [(singularCohomologyExteriorPower X n).map_smul,
        (singularCohomologyCup X 1 n (n + 1) (Nat.add_comm 1 n) a).map_smul]
      exact (LinearMap.range (singularCohomologyExteriorPower X (n + 1))).smul_mem r ih

/-- Surjectivity of pullback transports surjectivity of the cup comparison. -/
theorem singularCohomologyExteriorPower_surjective_of_pullback (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    (hf : Function.Surjective (singularCohomologyPullback f n))
    (hY : Function.Surjective (singularCohomologyExteriorPower Y n)) :
    Function.Surjective (singularCohomologyExteriorPower X n) := by
  intro c
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hf c
  exact singularCohomologyExteriorPower_pullback_mem_range f n (hY b)

/-- The cup-compatible circle splitting propagates surjectivity in positive
degree from the two adjacent degrees of the first factor. -/
theorem circleProductCohomologyExteriorPower_surjective (X : TopCat) (v : Circle)
    (n : ℕ)
    (hn : Function.Surjective (singularCohomologyExteriorPower X n))
    (hsucc : Function.Surjective (singularCohomologyExteriorPower X (n + 1))) :
    Function.Surjective
      (singularCohomologyExteriorPower (TopCat.of (X × Circle)) (n + 1)) := by
  intro c
  obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, rfl⟩ := (circleProductCohomologyEquiv X v n).symm.surjective c
  rw [circleProductCohomologyEquiv_symm_apply_cup]
  apply (LinearMap.range
    (singularCohomologyExteriorPower (TopCat.of (X × Circle)) (n + 1))).add_mem
  · exact singularCohomologyExteriorPower_pullback_mem_range
      (TopCat.ofHom ⟨Prod.fst, continuous_fst⟩) (n + 1) (hsucc a)
  · apply singularCohomologyExteriorPower_cup_mem_range
    exact singularCohomologyExteriorPower_pullback_mem_range
      (TopCat.ofHom ⟨Prod.fst, continuous_fst⟩) n (hn b)

end Mumford.Analytic
